displayDescription: Torn paper cutouts are pasted onto a slate archival board, then pinned and joined by thread into one connected system.
styleRenderer: PixiJS 8.22 (WebGL) compositing sprites, Graphics thread and pins
Canvas 2D procedural texture generation (paper, halftone photos, tape, shadows, board)
chroma-js palette validation and contrast checks
motionEngine: GSAP 3 paused timeline created and registered inline in index.html at window.__timelines.video; scene.js adds all tweens to it (sole owner of all animated state; Pixi redraws from it on seek)
limitations: Silent preview: no audio track, music, voice or sound effects were created.
Photographs are procedural luminance-halftone illustrations generated in Canvas 2D (lightbulb, node network, gear, arch bridge); no real or period photographs were supplied or used.
Paper grain, fibres, torn/deckled edges, foxing, tape translucency and drop shadows are seeded procedural approximations, not scanned materials or physically simulated paper.
Depth is a 2D approximation: per-layer parallax offsets and lift-dependent shadows; no 3D camera or lighting.
Body columns on the newspaper are deliberately illegible set-type bars; only the masthead, headline, subhead and the 'Fig. 1' caption are readable copy.
Canvas-rendered copy is not inspectable by DOM text-contrast audits; contrast was resolved in code with chroma.contrast (ink #393329 on paper #EDE3CD, 9.8:1). The board carries no text.
PixiJS Application.init is asynchronous; frames are redrawn on every timeline seek and on hf-seek once the WebGL renderer is ready.
BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json listed no matched sources and no contact sheets, so no source-frame observations were applied; the slate board is an authored scene-dependent choice.
Blender was not used, per user instruction.
Not rendered or browser-tested by the agent; host QA pending.
